escapes.name: T27 straight escape
escapes.source_note: The final hairpin has ordinary asphalt escape pavement and separate narrow green edge paint. This branch is plain asphalt; it does not recolor the whole corner or modify the inside island. Preserve the separate pit entry. Footprint dimensions are bounded reference/map reconstruction estimates, not measured barrier coordinates. The existing racing centreline, width, elevation and camera remain fixed.

source_status: Source-plan candidate awaiting mapped occupied-domain, grade, native protection and cooked visual review. Official map epoch2025; supplied edited-reference event year unverified. No survey claim.

paint_strips.source_note: Retained 291/331 s final-hairpin views show ordinary dark asphalt with local narrow turquoise/green boundary paint.
